patient discount

Various discounts can be applied for patients, such as user-wise limit discount and date-wise discount. If a billing user has the privilege to give a discount, it can be applied on the billing screen up to the limits specified for that particular user. Additionally, to associate any discount profile with a patient's bill, select the details from the 'Reference' field and then click on the 'Apply' button. A discount will be automatically applied on the bill. 

![Related Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_113427.png)

c scan

The 'CScan' form is used to scan the cards submitted by patients, such as insurance cards. This screen can be accessed by clicking the 'CScan' button from the OP service billing screen. The fields that are colored in red are mandatory. You can enter the file number manually or select it using the nearby button. After entering the file number, the system will automatically fill in the remaining characters. For more details, you can refer to the image below.

![Related Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114401.png)

Patient attached documents can be viewed on click of the ‘VScan’ button. These can be printed, downloaded, and can be converted to PDF format.

refferel

The 'Referral' section is used to specify details related to patient referrals. Key fields include:

1. **From**: This field is used to search the bills sent to the external center from a particular date.
2. **To**: This field is used to search the bills sent to the external center up to a particular date.
3. **Referral No**: This field is used to search the bills based on the referral number, which is generated at the referral hospital.

When a referral for a patient is requested by a doctor, the details will load on 'EMR Ordered' in the left side of the form. Upon clicking to bill, the system automatically loads the details of the referred doctor into the appropriate fields.

![Related Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_113800.png)

External Appointment

The 'External Appointments' form is used for selecting the appointments scheduled by the patients from an online portal. This screen can be accessed by clicking the 'External' button from the OP service billing screen. Key fields include:

1. **From**: This field is used to specify the appointments from a particular date.
2. **To**: This field is used to specify the appointments up to a particular date.
3. **Patient Name**: This field is used to specify the name of the patient.

When the patient is ready to make the payment, click on the ‘Estimate’ button to view the estimated bill. You can also generate printouts of the service and deduct bills by clicking on the 'Print Bill' and 'Print Deduct Bill' checkboxes respectively.

Download Referred Services

To download referred services, you must first map the referred service to the same service at the outside investigation center in the interbranch item mapping. After the services are mapped properly, select the bill and click download. If the patient is not already registered in this center, you must register them by clicking on the new button, which opens the registration form. If the patient is already registered, click on existing to filter the patient based on the registered document ID. After registering, the bill can be utilized. 

![Related Image](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114841.png)

If you need to reprint a previously billed invoice, click the 'Reprint' button to load the previous details. For more information, refer to the image below.
